pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo tattheva rājagahe vassaṃ vasanti tattha hemantaṃ tattha gimhaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.4: āhundarikā bhikkhunīnaṃ disā andhakārā na imāsaṃ disā pakkhāyantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.6: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.8: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.9: tenahi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.12: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.13.1: yā pana bhikkhunī vassaṃ vutthā cārikaṃ na pakkameyya antamaso chappañcayojanānipi pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:2.1.6: purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ vutthā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:2.1.7: cārikaṃ na pakkamissāmi antamaso chappañcayojanānīti dhūraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
